newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Jan house material prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Jan house material prices fall.

text.p: Australian house building materials prices fell 0.1 percent in January from December and were 0.2 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
Other building material prices rose 0.2 percent in January and were 0.3 percent higher than a year before.
The bureau said a decrease in prices for cupboards and fittings was the main contributor to the fall in the housing materials price index.
The small rise in the non-housing materials index was mainly due to an increase in the price for ready mixed concrete, the bureau said.
